name: GeoJSON Inspector
description: Offline RFC 7946 diagnostics: structure members, coordinate nesting, ring closure, bbox and antimeridian semantics, with a classified issue list and source locations
help: Paste GeoJSON or open a local .geojson/.json file; parsing, rule checks and reports run fully offline — no network access and no auto-fixing.

Diagnostics come in three levels: error = spec-mandatory violation (MUST), warning = compatibility concern (SHOULD/MAY, e.g. empty coordinates, extra dimensions), hint = heuristic (suspected swapped lon/lat, ring winding, legacy CRS).
Coordinates are interpreted longitude-first, latitude-second; suspected swaps are reported, never swapped automatically. A bbox with west > east is a legal antimeridian crossing, not an error.

Scope: single-document structural checks; this is not a full OGC topology validity check (self-intersections are not detected). Input size, depth, coordinate and diagnostic counts are capped; hitting a cap marks the report as incomplete.

result.title: Verdict
result.incomplete: A limit was hit, the report is incomplete and must not be treated as fully passing

errors.geojson.no_result: No verdict yet; run an inspection first
errors.geojson.not_file: The selection is not a regular file
errors.geojson.file_too_large: The file exceeds the {{mb}} MB limit
errors.geojson.file_encoding: The file is not UTF-8 encoded
errors.geojson.more_of_code: Many similar issues; showing the first {{limit}}
errors.geojson.root_object: The root must be a GeoJSON object (§3.3)
errors.geojson.geometry_object: A Geometry must be an object
errors.geojson.coords_missing: The geometry lacks the coordinates member (§3.1)
errors.geojson.null_geometry: A geometries element is null; some implementations treat it as an empty geometry
errors.geojson.not_feature: Elements of features must be Feature objects (§3.2)
errors.geojson.feature_members: Feature lacks the geometry or properties member (§3.2)
errors.geojson.properties_object: properties must be an object or null (§3.2)
errors.geojson.position_array: A Position must be an array (§3.1.1)
errors.geojson.position_dims: A Position needs at least two elements: longitude and latitude (§3.1.1)
errors.geojson.position_extra: More than three dimensions; most implementations keep only the first three (SHOULD NOT)
errors.geojson.maybe_swapped: Suspected swapped lon/lat (latitude out of range when longitude-first); the tool never swaps values
errors.geojson.line_too_short: A line needs at least two positions (§3.1.4)
errors.geojson.ring_array: A ring must be an array of positions (§3.1.6)
errors.geojson.ring_too_short: A linear ring needs at least four positions (§3.1.6)
errors.geojson.ring_not_closed: The linear ring is not closed (§3.1.6)
errors.geojson.ring_winding: Ring winding differs from the right-hand rule suggestion (exterior CCW, holes CW); parsers should not reject, confirm only
errors.geojson.empty_coords: Empty coordinates: RFC 7946 allows interpreting them as an empty geometry (MAY)
errors.geojson.bbox_mismatch: Coordinates fall outside this bbox (antimeridian crossing respected)
errors.geojson.legacy_crs: RFC 7946 removed the CRS member; coordinates are WGS84 lon/lat (§4); informational
